pin_regs.reason: The parent registers its own boundary in RTL (ot_hgi_dma_back_static_vp4_banks_cpl): every rr bit lands in a kept clk_rst register at its face (valid twice: bank copy + controller copy), wd/rq/host bus/status are child pin flops (bank wd_payload/wd_valid, controller rq/status registers, collar pin flops), wb_fill_* are relayed; a generic parent pin flop would add a second unpriced cycle on rr/wd/rq and the F20 host bus.

slot_change_request: hb_dbk_<q> (d4f slot 560.0 x 400.0) -> 606.96 x 542.16 (1.12:1): 8 banks + controller + collar leaf on the 43.2 lattice cannot fit 560 x 400 (see make_dbk_cpl_parent.py); master ports: clk_tab[1:0] removed, clk_rst added (reset relay root, same die clock); rr/rq W, wd/wb/wa N, F20 host bus/status/straps E, clk_bank on the nearest face (W x3, N x3, S x1, E x1); OWNERS-HBM/STK 10-18: 606.96 x 542.16 (macro_edge 20 um), wd of bank rows 0-1 on the S face, rows 2-3 on N (wire_reach), F20 host bus over the full E face; HBM-DBKCPL 10-18: rr of the col2 banks (rr[514..769] bank 2 -> S face, rr[1799..2054] bank 7 -> N face, beside their wd; rr_valid stays W) for daemon bank_distance (157 um).
structural_change: PARALLEL FALLBACK of hv16_dbk_cpl_l1 (same RTL and relay stations): child halo 5.4 -> 10.8 um AND lanes 2/7 rr groups pulled over their banks (S/N x 466-600, make_pins.py --compact27) (pin-access room at the bank / controller faces, as s2 for s1). HBM-HC7-DBK 10-20 (H.STA.BLK.12): LANDED consumer-geometry successor after Codex 04:04 REVIEW REFUSED (exact post-GRT buffer-transparent reach of s1/s2 @ca6707526: 11 captures > 405 um, max 713.268 rr[2055] W-face valid -> bank7.write_en, 566.1 / 540.8 rr valid -> bank2 / bank6, controller bank_output_en[7] / bank_read_en[7] -> bank7 454.7 / 408.2, reset landing (E y 2.4) -> u_rst_bk leaves 456.4). New master ot_hgi_dma_back_static_vp4_banks_cpl (same ports): every rr bit lands in a kept clk_rst register at the face beside its bank, the valid bit twice (bank copy half way to write_en, controller copy half way to rr_valid_i); bank_read_en / output_en / read slot / read address relayed one edge per bank (kept, half way controller face -> bank pins); wb_fill_* relayed with wd; bank 5 takes the W-face write-slot copy (383 um); rr valid ports beside each bank, rst_n beside clk_rst (E y 195); reset relay leaves half way to their bank, sync pair + rl1 at the centre station (relay_anchor_l1.txt, physical/common_flow/relay_anchor.tcl). Cycles (static, die schedule): rr -1 edge at the port (die pads rr lanes to RR_RT-1), wd / wb_fill_* +1 edge, reset release unchanged, controller frame unchanged (closed rt80 view). Same children, same floorplan. CLOCK (gate 20261020-054637 FAIL: one clk_rst tree over 2,425 flops, TT insertion 650.7 / boundary pin-flop spread 284.6 > 80): eight regional CTS roots clk_land[b] (new die-forwarded clock ports, one per bank region, at the centre of the lane's rr face group) clock the landing + read relays of bank b; clk_rst keeps only the reset relays + wb_fill relays (~33 sinks). CLOCK 2 (gates 063306/063307: clk_land[1]/[2] boundary spread 77.2-85.0 with one root over the face landing AND the mid-way relays): clk_land[b] keeps only the face landing (rr data + bank valid copy, ~258 flops in one face strip); the read relays + controller valid copy move to three relay-region roots clk_rly[S/W/N] (new die-forwarded ports).

job.purpose: HBM die d4g hb_dbk_<q> x4 (per quadrant, master unchanged; F20 tgt 104+QID: SW 104 / SE 105 / NW 106 / NE 107; RBH-STK). Measured reasons (hv15_dbk_cp gate 1f18141cb, 10-16): clk_cp 1,844 sinks TT 421.6 / spread 126.5 (collar flops smeared between the 8 banks), rst_n port -> 793 loads unregistered incl. 8 bank macros + controller (in->macro -296.1), in->reg -170.8 u_cp.cmd[26] with the W face 98% pin-full; children off the 43.2 um lattice; 645.84 x 360.72 (1.79:1).  Why not the d4f slot 560 x 400: on the 43.2 um child lattice three 87.48-um bank rows need y = 43.2/172.8/302.4 (top 389.9, no N channel left in 400) and three 140.4-um columns need x up to 529.2, so 560 x 400 holds at most 2 x 3 = 6 banks; 8 banks + controller + collar leaf = 10 objects, and every bank must stay within ~480 um of BOTH the W face (rr) and the N face (wd) (textbook wire_reach 500 um/stage).  A 3-row ring (controller centre) cannot take the leaf within 1.5:1 (width >= 712 at height 432).  Chosen: 4 rows x 3 columns, 604.8 x 540 (1.12:1):   * col0 (x 86.4, 4 banks; 86.4 um W channel carries their 1,156 wd bits N), col1/col2 (x 259.2/432) banks in rows 0     and 3; the controller in col1 between rows 1-2 (bank star <= ~430 um), the collar leaf in col2 between rows 1-2     (W face -> controller E face 104 um; E face 21.6 um from the cluster E face where the F20 host bus enters);   * channels >= 32.4 um (columns) / 42.1 um (rows), every child on the 43.2 lattice;   * W face: rr per bank row (rq + rr_valid beside the controller row), <= 4.6 pins/um; N face: wd per bank column + wb/wa,     <= 4.5 pins/um; each clk_bank entry on the face point nearest its bank clock pin; clk_cp at the leaf clock pin.
